svg.title: Figure 5-1. The vehicle verification cases (WP-S-09 §5)
svg.desc: 20 vehicle verification cases of WP-S-09 §5. VS-SQ-01 EPS LKA torque authority: covers AOU, TSR-1; early. VS-SQ-02 EPS timeout and request-bit behaviour: covers AOU, TSR-1; early; test build. VS-SQ-03 Envelope-bounded worst case: lateral deviation: covers TSR-1; test build. VS-SQ-04 Brake override: covers AOU, TSR-3; early. VS-SQ-05 PCM ACC envelope and cancel: covers AOU, TSR-2; early; test build. VS-SQ-06 Stock PCS preserved: covers AOU, TSR-7; early. VS-SQ-07 Cluster cruise indication independence: covers AOU, TSR-3. VS-SQ-08 Engagement and disengagement end-to-end: covers SYS, TSR-3. VS-SQ-09 Gas override: covers SYS, TSR-2, TSR-3. VS-SQ-10 Steering override: covers TSR-3; expected to fail. VS-SQ-11 Accel / decel limits and jerk on vehicle: covers SYS, TSR-2. VS-SQ-12 SoC loss while driving: covers TSR-4, TSR-5; test build; expected to fail. VS-SQ-13 Fault-induced lateral safe-state transition in a curve: covers SYS, TSR-1, TSR-6; test build. VS-SQ-14 Longitudinal safe-state transition: covers SYS, TSR-2, TSR-6. VS-SQ-15 Driver monitoring escalation and lockout: covers SYS, TSR-6. VS-SQ-20 Start-up fault-code read, per ECU: covers AOU, TSR-6. VS-SQ-16 Process replay regression: covers SYS, TSR-6. VS-SQ-17 Safety replay of the full Corolla log set: covers TSR-1, TSR-2, TSR-3, TSR-4. VS-SQ-18 Controller margin to envelope: covers SYS, TSR-6; expected to fail. VS-SQ-19 Supervised endurance drive: covers SYS, TSR-1, TSR-2, TSR-3, TSR-4, TSR-5, TSR-6, TSR-7.
svg.text: Figure 5-1 · The vehicle verification cases and what each covers
The 20 cases of §5 by where they run, the requirement groups each covers, and three flags: 5 decide a HARA rating, 5 need a test build, 3 are expected to fail; none executed
early (OI-4) · test build (OI-2) · expected to fail
Accel / decel limits and jerk on vehicle
Fault-induced lateral safe-state transition in a curve
Safety replay of the full Corolla log set
covers assumptions of use or system requirements
TSR blocks 5xx (the MCU platform) are verified on the bench, in WP-S-08, WP-H-06 and WP-V-05.

Early: the result decides a HARA controllability rating marked ⚠, so it runs at G1. Test build: a closed-course host or panda build that injects out-of-range commands, reflashed after every session (DQ-105 B).
Generated by fig_s09_cases.py from WP-S-09 §5 (cases and Trace column) and §8 (OI-2, OI-4); nothing is hand-listed.

g.text: Terms: ACC adaptive cruise control · AoU assumption of use: what the analysis assumes about the car, the driver or the environment · DQ-nn decision of the project lead (decision register) · ECU electronic control

unit · EPS electric power steering · G0–G6 gate G0…G6 of the project lifecycle · HARA hazard analysis and risk assessment (ISO 26262-3) · LKA lane keeping assist · MCU microcontroller: the panda safety processor

(STM32H7) · OI-nn open item of the document it appears in · PCM powertrain control module (engine and drive) · PCS pre-collision system: Toyota's stock collision warning and braking · SoC system on chip: the comma

device's main processor, running openpilot (QM) · SYS system requirement SYS-nnn of WP-S-01 · TSR-nn technical safety requirement (WP-S-02) · VS-nn verification case: VS-SI system integration, VS-HW hardware, VS-SWQ

software, VS-FI fault injection, VS-SQ system qualification · WP-nn work product, e.g. WP-C-04; the letter is its area (M management, C concept, S system, H hardware, W software, V validation, P processes, A
analyses, O operation, K safety case)
